headline: Sensex closes at a three-week high; Brent near $109 and a US chip/AI selloff set the tone ahead of a holiday-shortened week

points.t: Sensex jumped over 1,500 points to close at a three-week high.
points.why: A strong close going into the week lifts sentiment, though it faces the oil and foreign-flow drivers below.

points.t: Brent crude hovers near $109 a barrel as Ukraine resumes energy strikes and tankers are attacked in the Middle East, while another report says WTI fell $3 after Vance signalled possible de-escalation in the Iran war.
points.why: Crude drives India's import bill, inflation and oil-marketer margins, and the headlines point in different directions.

points.t: Citi raised its 2026 Brent forecast and sees $150 oil if the Hormuz disruption persists.
points.why: Higher oil would widen India's import bill and pressure the rupee.

points.t: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq logged their worst week since June on AI debt fears, and chip stocks extended an eight-day losing streak.
points.why: AI capital spending worries weigh on global tech sentiment and on India's AI data-centre and EMS themes.

points.t: US ten-year Treasury yields are set for their biggest weekly loss in more than a year.
points.why: Falling US yields usually ease pressure on foreign flows into emerging markets such as India.

points.t: A weak rupee pushes India's $5-trillion economy milestone to 2029 per IMF data, and Indian importers continue hedging despite higher costs after RBI measures.
points.why: Rupee weakness and the RBI's response affect importers, foreign-flow sentiment and inflation.

points.t: Adani Power buys a 24% stake in Jaiprakash Power Ventures for Rs 2,994 crore, and KSB bags an order from ONGC.
points.why: Deals and order wins move the power and capital-goods sectors.

points.t: Reports say Trump signed an oil deal with Russia despite sanctions on India last month, and the India-US trade deal remains held up.
points.why: Trade and sanctions policy bears on exporters and on India's Russian crude sourcing.

watch: Trading holiday for Dussehra on October 20 or 21 (exact day per Goodreturns headline)
Reliance Jio IPO, crude volatility, FII selling and Q2 results flagged as factors for the week
